title: A compatible system of finite etale infinitesimal covers
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a scheme morphism [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $X_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-fibre-product]. For every finite etale cover $V\to X_0$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], there are schemes $V_n$ with finite etale morphisms $v_n:V_n\to X_n$, maps $g_n:V_n\to V_{n+1}$ whose squares over the canonical maps $X_n\to X_{n+1}$ are cartesian, and an isomorphism $V_0\cong V$ over $X_0$. No properness, Noetherianity, or completeness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Fundamental Groups, Lemma 0GS2, essential-surjectivity proof, complete Noetherian case

proof.text: (The thickenings $Y_m\subseteq Y_n$.) For $0\le m\le n$ the closed immersion $S_m\to S_n$ is defined by the ideal $I^{m+1}/I^{n+1}$ of $A/I^{n+1}$, whose $(n+1)$-st power is $0$; every prime of $A/I^{n+1}$ contains this nilpotent ideal, so $S_m\to S_n$ is surjective. By transitivity of fibre products $Y_m=Y\times_SS_m\cong Y_n\times_{S_n}S_m$, so $j_{m,n}:Y_m\to Y_n$ is the base change of $S_m\to S_n$ along $Y_n\to S_n$; hence it is a closed immersion [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-base-change] and surjective [lem-weil-pbc-surjective-base-change]. Its ideal sheaf is $I^{m+1}\mathcal O_{Y_n}$, whose $(n+1)$-st power is $I^{(m+1)(n+1)}\mathcal O_{Y_n}=0$ as $I^{n+1}\mathcal O_{Y_n}=0$; so $Y_m\subseteq Y_n$ is a finite order thickening [def-sbc-first-order-thickening]. By [lem-weil-pbc-surjective-closed-immersion-universal-homeomorphism] each $j_{m,n}$, in particular $j_{n,n+1}:Y_n\to Y_{n+1}$ and $j_{0,n}:Y_0\to Y_n$, is a universal homeomorphism.

source.place: Fundamental Groups, Lemma 0GS2 (label lemma-finite-etale-on-proper-over-henselian-pair), proof, paragraph 'Essential surjectivity when A is Noetherian and I-adically complete' (same as the complete local case of Lemma 0A48); 'Let X_n = X x_{Spec A} Spec(A/I^{n+1}) ... the inclusions X_0 -> X_1 -> X_2 -> ...'

proof.text: (Lifting $V$ to a compatible system of etale $Y_n$-schemes.) Put $V_0=V$. Given an etale $Y_n$-scheme $V_n$, apply [lemma-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-site-equivalence] to the universal homeomorphism $j_{n,n+1}:Y_n\to Y_{n+1}$ (the preceding thickening construction): base change along $j_{n,n+1}$ is an equivalence from etale $Y_{n+1}$-schemes to etale $Y_n$-schemes, so there are an etale $Y_{n+1}$-scheme $V_{n+1}$ and an isomorphism of $Y_n$-schemes $V_{n+1}\times_{Y_{n+1}}Y_n\cong V_n$. Composing it with the projection gives $V_n\to V_{n+1}$ over $j_{n,n+1}$, and the square formed by $V_n\to V_{n+1}$, $V_n\to Y_n$, $V_{n+1}\to Y_{n+1}$, $j_{n,n+1}$ is cartesian by construction. By induction and transitivity of fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product], $V_n\times_{Y_n}Y_0\cong V$ as $Y_0$-schemes for every $n$. (Stacks cites Etale Morphisms, Theorem 039R, for thickenings with the same underlying space, which is the case here; the DAG node is its generalization to universal homeomorphisms, Stacks 04DZ, whose Lean `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isEquivalence_etale` is sorry-free on slopmaster2.)

source.place: Fundamental Groups, Lemma 0GS2 (label lemma-finite-etale-on-proper-over-henselian-pair), proof, paragraph 'Essential surjectivity when A is Noetherian and I-adically complete' (same as the complete local case of Lemma 0A48); 'By Etale Morphisms, Theorem 039R the inclusions ... induce equivalence of categories between the category of schemes etale over X_0 and the category of schemes etale over X_n'

proof.text: (Each $V_n\to Y_n$ is finite.) By the preceding thickening construction, $Y_0\subseteq Y_n$ is a finite order thickening, and by the preceding inductive construction, $V\cong Y_0\times_{Y_n}V_n$ as $Y_0$-schemes, i.e. $V\to Y_0$ is the base change of $V_n\to Y_n$. Since $V\to Y_0$ is finite, [lem-weil-pbc-thickening-finite-cartesian] shows that $V_n\to Y_n$ is finite. So $(V_n\to Y_n)_n$ is a system of finite morphisms with cartesian transition squares.

source.place: Fundamental Groups, Lemma 0GS2 (label lemma-finite-etale-on-proper-over-henselian-pair), proof, paragraph 'Essential surjectivity when A is Noetherian and I-adically complete' (same as the complete local case of Lemma 0A48); 'if U_n -> X_n corresponds to a finite etale morphism U_0 -> X_0, then U_n -> X_n is finite too, for example by More on Morphisms, Lemma 09ZW'

proof.text: Choose these lifts recursively on n. The initial cover is transported from V along I^1=I, retaining its isomorphism over the closed fibre. Return the schemes V_n, their finite etale structure maps, and the cartesian transitions. The construction requires neither completeness nor properness.

theorem exists_finiteEtale_infinitesimal_system
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (V : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤
      (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))))) :
    ∃ (Yn : ℕ → Scheme.{u})
      (fnY : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ pullback f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))
      (gn : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ Yn (n + 1)),
      (∀ n, IsFinite (fnY n) ∧ Etale (fnY n)) ∧
      (∀ n, IsPullback (fnY n) (gn n)
      (pullback.map f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))
        f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))) (𝟙 X)
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
        (𝟙 _) (by simp)
        (by rw [Category.comp_id, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
              Ideal.Quotient.factor_comp_mk]))
      (fnY (n + 1))) ∧
      Nonempty (Over.mk (show Yn 0 ⟶ pullback f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) from
          by rw [← pow_one I]; exact fnY 0) ≅ Over.mk V.hom)
